normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, collapse whitespace; exact answer match; no punctuation stripping
forbidden_match: normalized literal with Unicode word boundaries, not numeric substrings
retention: supported answer literal must occur in a rendered fragment from its truth-designated source message; contradictions require both original source statements; no-answer is not applicable
denominator: all planned slots; missing, error and required-non-fit are never correct
claims: synthetic scorer verification only; live model quality, usage and calibration NOT_EVALUATED
live_import: rejected; requires separately approved execution identity and provider receipts
